# tripspace.global Blog

> Travel insights, hosting guides, property and rental news, and founder stories from tripspace.global — a free-to-list marketplace for holiday stays, property for sale, rentals and accommodation businesses for sale, built in Cape Town, South Africa.

tripspace.global started as a commission-free alternative to Booking.com and Airbnb, where hosts keep 100% of every booking. In November 2026 it became free to list for four things: holiday stays, property for sale, short and long-term rentals, and accommodation businesses for sale. There is no monthly fee and no commission on sales or rentals. Anything listed while the platform is free will not be charged for. Whether listings added later will carry a fee has not been decided, and any change will be announced on the site first.

## Platform Summary

- **Four ways in**: Stay (holiday homes, guesthouses, hotels), Buy (property for sale), Rent (short-term by the night, long-term by the month), and Take over a stay (accommodation businesses for sale).
- **Free to list**: no monthly fee, no commission on sales or rentals. Owners, landlords, agents and brokers can all list, and one seller profile can hold several listings.
- **Commission-free stays**: hosts keep 100% of every booking.
- **Search and filters**: property type, price range, bedrooms, owner or broker, and sort by newest, price or location.
- **Listing details**: bedrooms, bathrooms, floor size, parking, levies and rates; for short-term rentals the minimum and maximum stay; for long-term rentals the lease length and deposit.
- **Direct contact**: sellers can share phone, WhatsApp and email, shown to signed-in visitors who tap Contact seller; brokers can add a website link. Internal messaging is also available.
- **Listing controls**: edit, hide and unhide, mark as sold or let. Sold listings are deleted automatically after one week, or immediately on request.
- **Photo checks**: images that are explicit or irrelevant to property, accommodation or a business for sale are blocked.
- **Support**: support@tripspaceglobal.com, with bugs and issues targeted for resolution within 24 hours.
- **What it is not**: tripspace.global is a listings platform, not an estate agent. It does not hold money and does not guarantee listings or sellers.
- **Other features**: Aria (AI travel assistant), TripVerify (video-verified host badges), SpaceChat (host-traveller messaging), TripGuard (AI vehicle damage assessment), DeviceGuard (optional GPS tracking).
